_about: Week-of openers from the Oct 27 notes research (notes.json movement). 'confirmed': Sportsbook Review and Bookmakers Review agree exactly. 'direction': they differ but agree the line moved the same way; the opener closer to the current line is used so the move is never overstated. Action Network and VegasInsider 'open' columns are lookahead lines and are not used. spread_h = home spread.
